light.name: Light
light.desc: Images almost untouched. For printing or archiving.

balanced.name: Recommended
balanced.desc: Images stay sharp on screen, file clearly lighter.

strong.name: Strong
strong.desc: The lightest file. Images lose some detail.

hint: Only images are made lighter: text stays sharp and selectable. The gain is large on scans and photos, small on a PDF that is mostly text, and more modest than with an online service. The real sizes, before and after, are shown at the end.
noteImages_one: {{count}} image made lighter out of {{total}}. Text is still selectable text.
noteImages_other: {{count}} images made lighter out of {{total}}. Text is still selectable text.
noteStructure: The images in this PDF were already well compressed: only the file structure was compacted.
noteNoImages: This PDF contains no images: only its structure could be compacted, so the gain stays modest.
noteSameNoImages: This PDF contains no images and its structure is already compact. It is returned as is.
noteSameImages: The images in this PDF are already well compressed, or in a format PidiElf prefers not to touch. The file is returned as is.
noteNoCodec: This browser cannot recompress images: only the file structure was optimised. A recent browser will give a better result.
noteBatchSame: Files that were already optimised are returned as is.
